plain_language.psa_sub: Planning middle for an unstamped blister. No graded blister sale yet.
plain_language.pcg_sub: Soft guess. No public sale yet. Flawless has no formula price.
plain_language.raw_sub: Near mint on TCGPlayer. About 105 listings.
plain_language.zero_sales: Still zero graded unstamped blister cosmos cards have sold. CGC has graded some copies, and none of those have sold. The cosmos price stays a projection from Perfect Order holo and reverse holo sales that have actually happened.
plain_language.method: Take this set’s reverse holo and multiply by how much more an older, similar cosmos sold for versus its own reverse. That lands near $487, just under the low end of the band. The planning middle is about $550, inside about $490 to $710.
plain_language.stamped_ceiling: A GameStop stamped PSA 10 around $710 is a hard ceiling. Stamped GameStop and EB Games cards are a different product, so they stay out of the blister comparison. The older guess near $686 is an optimistic read, up near that ceiling.
plain_language.anchors_intro: The regular holo and the reverse holo are close to the same PSA 10 price, about $245 to $275. The low end is the price guide. The high end is recent eBay sales. A reverse holo CGC pristine sold around $225 to $250.
plain_language.raw_note: Near mint raw blister copies are about $4 to $5 on TCGPlayer, product 709697, with about 105 listings and heavy volume. The September 24 eBay typical price of $8.83 is stale.
plain_language.pop_caveat: No public PCG sale has shown up for a Perfect Order Gengar, so the pristine guess stays soft, about $161. The Flawless 10 is listed so you can see it came back. There is no formula price for it.
plain_language.chart_note: The planning middle sits between the reverse-holo math and the stamped ceiling.
plain_language.confidence: Confidence is still low to moderate, until the first blister gem sale prints. Top-grade supply is rising: this batch came back with a high share of Pristine and Flawless, and raw copies are flooding the market. That extra supply can press on prices.
plain_language.timeline_intro: Grades do not all show up the week the packs hit shelves. Here is where this card stands.

steps.title: The packs hit shelves
steps.body: Pitch Black blisters went on sale. This card is the Perfect Order Gengar #050 cosmos holo from those blister packs.

steps.title: The grading order was placed
steps.body: Order #5011048 went in for 20 blister cosmos copies of #050.

steps.title: PCG received the cards
steps.body: The 20 cards were received for grading.

steps.title: The grades came back
steps.body: You are here. The batch came back as one Flawless 10 (certificate #000348838), eight Pristine 10s, six Gem Mint 10s, four Gem Mint 9.5s, and one Near Mint 7. This looks like the entire public PCG population for this card. The counts are the grades in hand. No graded unstamped blister cosmos has sold, and no public PCG sale of a Perfect Order Gengar has shown up.

steps.title: PSA 10s often start to show
steps.body: The first PSA 10s for a new set often take about four to five months after the packs hit shelves. From mid-July, that is roughly November into December.
